# SEVITSIL®

> SEVITSIL® is India's leading silicone products manufacturer since 1975 — premium silicone tubing, hoses, extrusions, gaskets, moulded articles and single-use assemblies for medical, pharma, biotech, electrical, food, dairy and industrial applications. US FDA, ISO and USP Class VI certified, exporting to 35+ countries.

## Industry Solutions

- [Medical Grade Solutions](/products/tubing/medical-solutions): Medical-grade silicone tubing and components — USP Class VI, ISO 10993, biocompatible.
- [Pharma & Biotech Solutions](/products/tubing/pharma-biotech-solutions): Pharma-grade silicone for bioprocessing, transfer lines and single-use assemblies.
- [Electrical Grade Solutions](/products/tubing/electrical-solutions): High-dielectric silicone insulation sleeves, corona-treater sleeves and electrical components.
